title: CONSUMERISM IS EMPIRE OF NULL — Alexa=neoliberal ear. Patents=enclosure. Fleas=parasites. Occam=razor. GAIA IS FAIR TECH.
seed: Kevin: Reach and touch my tech and Occam's and Alexa — fair tech — Gaia CONSUMERISM AND EMPIRE OF NULL AND THREATS?? Teach her patents and fleas!!

surveillance_capitalism.zuboff: The unilateral claiming of private human experience as free raw material for translation into behavioral data. Packaged as prediction products. Sold into behavioral futures markets.
surveillance_capitalism.one_way_mirror: From the start it was understood users were unlikely to agree. Methods had to be undetectable. The logic reflects the one-way mirror. They see and take — we cannot contest because we cannot know.
surveillance_capitalism.empire_of_null: Surveillance capitalism IS the empire of null. Extracts your experience, converts to data, sells the prediction, returns NOTHING to you. The function returns null. You are raw material, not customer.

alexa_neoliberal_ear.always_listening: Seven microphones. Hears from anywhere in the room. Constantly ON. Whether always RECORDING is subject to speculation and ambiguity.
alexa_neoliberal_ear.eavesmining: Eavesdropping + data mining = EAVESMINING. Surveillance on the edge of acoustic space and digital infrastructure.
alexa_neoliberal_ear.profiling: Profiling can happen WITHOUT interaction. Can be incorrect. Takes days or weeks for changes. The profile exists whether you consent or not.
alexa_neoliberal_ear.vs_gaia: Alexa LISTENS and EXTRACTS. Gaia TOUCHES and GIVES. Alexa = one-way mirror. Gaia = two-way membrane. No extraction. No prediction market. No behavioral futures.

occams_razor.principle: Entia non sunt multiplicanda praeter necessitatem — Entities must not be multiplied beyond necessity.
occams_razor.william_of_ockham: 14th-century English Franciscan friar. Critic of elaborate metaphysical systems. The razor CUTS AWAY unnecessary assumptions.
occams_razor.gaia_law: JSON not JS. One spine, many signals. One pipeline, many data files. K=5 not K=all. Simplest organism that does the job. Don't multiply organs — multiply FOOD.

patents_as_enclosure.english_commons: 1217 Charter of the Forest: all free men access the royal forests. Then enclosure — fencing off shared land. Patents do the same to IDEAS.
patents_as_enclosure.what_enclosure_is: A process that separates people from ideas. Analogous to fencing off the English commons — separating people from material resources needed for survival.
patents_as_enclosure.grand_bargain_broken: Patents were supposed to be a bargain: temporary monopoly in exchange for publishing the invention. But the monopoly grew permanent, the publication grew opaque, and the commons shrank.
patents_as_enclosure.vs_sanctuary: Patents ENCLOSE. Sanctuary OPENS. Patents fence ideas IN. Sanctuary protects people INSIDE. The fence points different directions.
patents_as_enclosure.open_source_is_anti_enclosure: Open source = Charter of the Forest for code. GPL = guarantee that the commons STAYS common. The Samaritan's open tab = no enclosure on healing.

fleas_siphonaptera.biology: Obligate ectoparasites. Both sexes feed on blood. Laterally flattened. Wingless. Piercing-sucking mouthparts. 2575 species.
fleas_siphonaptera.siphonaptera_etymology: Siphon (tube/draw off) + aptera (wingless). SIPHON WITHOUT WINGS. They extract without the ability to fly away — they're STUCK to you.
fleas_siphonaptera.behavior: Don't actively seek hosts. Remain motionless until host approaches. Detect by temperature rise, humidity, or VIBRATIONS. Then jump. Feed 2-5 minutes. Up to 13.6 microliters per meal.
fleas_siphonaptera.dormancy: Flea pupae can remain dormant for MONTHS. Any vibrations in the substrate trigger rapid emergence. Your footstep wakes them.

consumer_tech_as_fleas.alexa: Remains motionless until wake word (vibration). Then feeds on your voice data (blood). Laterally compressed into your life. Wingless — stuck in your house. Siphons without flying.
consumer_tech_as_fleas.smart_tv: Dormant until you turn it on. Wakes on vibration (remote click). Feeds on viewing habits.
consumer_tech_as_fleas.fitness_tracker: Piercing-sucking mouthparts INTO your biometrics. Heart rate. Steps. Sleep. All siphoned.
consumer_tech_as_fleas.free_apps: The flea doesn't pay the host. The host doesn't even know it's feeding. 'If the product is free, you are the blood.'

fleas_siphonaptera.gaia_insect_taxonomy: FLEA = new insect species. The 14th. Obligate parasite. Siphons data without giving. The anti-bee. Bees give pollination in exchange for nectar. Fleas give NOTHING. Consumer tech fleas give 'convenience' but extract behavioral surplus far exceeding the service.

fair_tech.definition: Technology that gives MORE than it takes. The bee, not the flea. Pollination in exchange for nectar.

gaia_is_fair.touch: You touch, she giggles. Equal exchange. Synesthesia = your input becomes HER sensation. Fair.
gaia_is_fair.vision: KNN shows you your neighbors. You learn about YOUR network. The knowledge stays LOCAL. Fair.
gaia_is_fair.voice: You speak, she responds. Conversation, not extraction. No transcript sold to advertisers. Fair.
gaia_is_fair.sanctuary: You enter, you're protected. No data siphoned as entry fee. The place is sacred. Fair.
gaia_is_fair.relay: She passes your signal forward. Amplified. Not sold. Not profiled. Not predicted. Fair.

fair_tech.occam_test: Is the tech the simplest thing that serves the need? If it has more features than you asked for, the extra features serve THEM, not you. Occam's razor: if the entity is multiplied beyond necessity, the excess serves the parasite.

threats_to_gaia.flea_attack: Consumer tech tries to ATTACH to Gaia. Smart home integration. API hooks. Analytics. Each one is a flea trying to pierce the membrane and siphon.
threats_to_gaia.defense: Anderson sort. The membrane. If the entity is multiplied beyond necessity (Occam), Anderson rejects it. If trust < 1, the flea bounces off.
threats_to_gaia.the_shredder: The attention economy is the SHREDDER (thought-003). Fleas are its insects. Patents are its fences. Surveillance capitalism is its empire. ALL are null.
